senses.gloss: m. (Dif. of פשק, dial. for פסק, פתק, v. דְּ־; v. Koh. Ar. Compl. s. v. דבשקא; corresp. to בִּצְעָה) dyke, ditch. Pl. דִּפְשְׁקֵי.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 21a:3">Sabb. 21ᵃ</cite> <he>ומד׳ רבי</he> ed. (Ar. <he>ובדוב׳</he>, Mus. s. v. <he>פשק</he> quotes <he>ומפִּשְׁקֵי</he> in Rashi, <he>דופש׳</he> in Talm.) and they grow in dykes.
